The largest bone in the human body is the femur (thigh bone).

Regarding the effectiveness of the described physical therapy technique, myofascial release therapy appears to be effective for specific conditions, particularly myofascial pain syndrome. By applying gentle, sustained pressure to the fascial connective tissues, this technique aims to relieve pain and increase range of motion. It targets sensitive points in the muscles, suggesting it is beneficial for treating restrictions in motion and pain caused by fascial tightness or injury.
